audit_doctrine_and_training.doctrine_summary: Audits physical containment: two closed doors, bolted support table, grey crate, blue tamper-evident corner seal on lid seam, 3 padlocks in separate locked cases.
audit_doctrine_and_training.review_methodology: Validates physical containment against strict custody rules: no solid-core doors, no bracket plates, no loose keys.
drift_detection_heuristics: Check that two closed doors exist between public corridor and room without 'solid-core' exaggeration
Check blue seal is tamper-evident corner seal across crate lid seam (not municipal door tag)
Verify 3 keys are isolated in locked cases (trunk, satchel, pack) with zero lanyards or pockets

drift_detection_patterns.failure_signature: Adding 'solid-core' or reinforced steel door claims
drift_detection_patterns.audit_result: PASS: Exact two closed doors established

drift_detection_patterns.failure_signature: Key carried on lanyard, loose in pocket, or biometric
